newsitem.title: USA: Nationsbank redeems Series A preferred shrs.
newsitem.headline: Nationsbank redeems Series A preferred shrs.

text.p: The NationsBank Corp Wednesday said its board has approved the redemption of all outstanding shares of its cumulative convertible preferred stock, Series A, effective March 31, 1997.
A company spokeswoman was unavailable to comment on the number or value of outstanding shares, or the price at which the shares will be redeemed.
The company also declared the regular quarterly cash dividend of $7 per share on its outstanding cumulative convertible preferred stock, Series A.
The dividend is payable March 1, 1997, to shareholders of record Feb. 19, 1997.

The company later said there were about 3.8 million depository shares outstanding at the end of 1996, and that each of the shares of convertible preferred stock was redeemable at $25 per share, or convertible to 0.562 shares of NationsBank common stock.
